name: Proposal for a decision
title: 2022 discharge: General budget of the EU - European Council and Council
part_text:
The European Parliament refuses to approve how the Council spent its share of the European Union budget in 2022. It says the Council has refused for years to answer Parliament's questions or attend hearings, so Parliament cannot check the spending properly. Parliament asks the Council to restart talks at the highest level to end the deadlock. It also repeats earlier criticisms, including about Hungary holding the Council presidency and about the rule requiring unanimous votes in some policy areas.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament withholds approval and asks for talks.
- **Who it affects:** The Council, its Secretary-General, and European Union taxpayers.
- **What happens next:** The Council is asked to negotiate with Parliament to break the deadlock.
